decks.notes: The core idea of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to aggressively reduce your own life total to strengthen Death's Shadow while controlling the opponent's resources with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional threats and card advantage, while Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger puts pressure on the opponent's hand and graveyard. Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder help provide information and fuel for Delirium. The deck aims to capitalize on the power of Death's Shadow and its synergies to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo using cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Colossus Hammer. The goal is to equip creatures with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer, Nettlecyst, and Sword of Fire and Ice to deal massive damage to opponents in a single turn. The deck includes tools like Sigarda's Aid and Steelshaper's Gift to help find and equip the necessary pieces quickly. With the right setup, this deck can surprise opponents with a lethal attack out of nowhere.

The deck focuses on using a combination of control elements such as counterspells and removal spells alongside aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes card selection and advantage engines like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain tempo and consistency. The key strategy is to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. Utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler, along with versatile cards like Archmage's Charm and Shark Typhoon, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards to maintain resources. With a mix of creature removal, board wipes, and permission spells, the deck aims to stabilize the board and take control of the game with powerful win conditions like Teferi or Shark Typhoon tokens.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, utilizing low-cost spells and counters to control the board and push damage through. Key cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. The deck's mana base supports a consistent early game with plenty of fetch lands and dual lands. The spells in the deck provide both disruption and burn damage to keep the opponent on their toes. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient threats while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes Elementals to generate value and provide synergy with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through flickering cards like Felidar Guardian and Karmic Guide. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents while maintaining control over the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and aggressive creatures to quickly reduce the opponent's life total, while also using cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Death's Shadow allows for a powerful threat that can grow in size based on the player's life total. The deck aims to control the board with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, while also generating card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion providing additional mana fixing and utility.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enters-the-battlefield triggers to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, the deck can search for specific creatures to combo off with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Grist, the Hunger Tide, or Blood Artist for a win condition. The deck also includes mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch to ramp into its bigger threats quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its versatile creatures and combos to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively building a board presence with powerful Merfolk creatures that buff each other, disrupting opponents' strategies with tempo plays like Merfolk Trickster and Subtlety, and protecting its own creatures with counterspells like Force of Negation. Aether Vial helps cheat out creatures to create an overwhelming battlefield presence, while cards like Spreading Seas and Tide Shaper disrupt opponent's lands. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy using Merfolk synergies.

This deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo with Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to equip large creatures with powerful equipment quickly. The deck includes ways to protect the combo pieces, such as Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce, as well as support cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Giver of Runes. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to find key artifacts and lands efficiently. By efficiently equipping creatures with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer and Shadowspear, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on using creatures with powerful abilities to build a toolbox that can be accessed through cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling. The key strategy is to generate value by sacrificing creatures like Young Wolf and Strangleroot Geist to Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, while also utilizing Grist, the Hunger Tide to create tokens and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Blood Artist provides additional reach, while Endurance acts as a disruptive element against graveyard strategies. The mana base is designed to support the deck's diverse casting requirements and ensure consistent access to key lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while building a strong board presence. By using a combination of powerful planeswalkers, efficient removal spells, and fast threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf, the deck aims to apply pressure from the early turns of the game. Additionally, the deck features disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Unholy Heat to control the opponent's hand and board. Overall, the deck looks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, disruption, and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid, and Colossus Hammer to equip a creature with the Hammer for a lethal attack. The deck includes various cards to tutor for the combo pieces, protect the creature carrying the Hammer, and disrupt opponents with counterspells. Urza's Saga can help find key artifacts like Colossus Hammer, while Esper Sentinel provides card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and go for a fast and powerful swing with a massive Hammer-equipped creature.

This deck focuses on equipping creatures with powerful equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and using Puresteel Paladin to reduce costs and draw cards. The key strategy is to quickly assemble a powerful creature equipped with multiple artifacts to deal massive damage and win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes protection cards like Burrenton Forge-Tender and Spellskite to ensure your combo pieces stay on the battlefield. Additionally, Urza's Saga is used to find key artifacts and create more tokens to further strengthen your board presence.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo using cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly equip creatures with Colossus Hammer and other powerful equipment cards. By utilizing cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga, the deck can efficiently get the necessary pieces onto the battlefield to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. The deck also includes protection and mana acceleration cards to ensure the combo can be executed smoothly and effectively.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The combination of Wrenn and Six and Hard Evidence helps to consistently hit land drops and create tokens for sacrificing to these spells. The deck also includes various interactive spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismari Command, and Spell Pierce to control the game until the combo can be set up. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide additional value and card advantage in longer games. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's strategy.
